pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot in Her Classic Top, Denim Shorts, and Sneakers Standing on N. Sanity Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot stands on N. Sanity Beach in this printable coloring page, wearing her classic cropped top, cuffed denim shorts, and lace-up sneakers. Her long swept hair and hand-on-hip pose dominate the coloring sheet, while palm trees, small beach stones, gentle waves, and a rocky island fill the tropical background.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Waiting at the End of a Classic Bonus Stage as Crash Jumps Across the Last Wooden Crates Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot waits on a wooden platform in this printable coloring page as Crash jumps across the final crates of a classic bonus stage. Her clasped hands and long hair face Crash's outstretched arm, with three reinforced crates spanning the gap. Cliff edges, tropical foliage, and distant peaks add smaller sections around the large character outlines.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot and Crash Riding a Giant Bird Away From the Great Hall in the Original Game's Secret Ending Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot and Crash ride a giant bird away from the Great Hall in this printable coloring page inspired by the original game's secret ending. Tawna sits behind Crash as the bird spreads its feathered wings above the island. Its curved beak, dangling talons, and layered tail contrast with the distant temple steps, coastline, and clouds on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Holding Her Hookshot in Her Spiked Jacket, Fingerless Gloves, and Leg Warmers Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot from Crash Bandicoot 4 holds her hookshot in this printable coloring page, wearing a spiked jacket, fingerless gloves, shorts, and leg warmers. Her swept hairstyle, ear jewelry, belt pouch, and buckled boots create distinct smaller details. Broad clothing and fur areas keep Tawna prominent against rocky ledges and a narrow rope bridge on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Wall-jumping Between Two Wooden Ship Walls in Hook, Line, and Sinker Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot wall-jumps between wooden ship walls in this printable coloring page set in Hook, Line, and Sinker from Crash Bandicoot 4. Her spread limbs brace against the planks, highlighting her spiked jacket, gloves, and heavy boots. Rope-wrapped posts and a distant ship surround the central pose, with long plank shapes and small rivets across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Breaking a Distant Wumpa Crate with Her Hookshot Across a Gap Between Docks Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot breaks a distant Wumpa crate with her hookshot in this printable coloring page, firing across the water-filled gap between two wooden docks. The taut cable ends in a burst of splintered boards as she braces her boots on the near platform. Rope-wrapped pilings, cross braces, and a palm-covered rocky island add structure around the open water.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Ground-pounding a Stack of Wooden Crates on a Pirate Ship Deck Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot ground-pounds a stack of wooden crates on a pirate ship deck in this printable coloring page from Crash Bandicoot 4. Her fist strikes the top box amid flying splinters, with both boots lifted beside her. The coloring sheet combines broad character areas with crate cross braces, deck planks, rope rigging, and a barrel near the railing.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Dodging a Cannonball on a Narrow Walkway Between Ship Masts Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot dodges a cannonball on a narrow walkway between ship masts in this printable coloring page, ducking beside the rope handrail as it passes. Her spiked jacket, belt pouch, and folded leg warmers stand out in the foreground. Repeating wooden boards lead toward a crow's nest, while rigging knots and a torn flag add smaller coloring details.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Discovering the Hidden Gem on a Raised Platform Beside a Pirate Ship Mast Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot discovers a hidden gem beside a pirate ship mast in this printable coloring page, kneeling and reaching toward its large faceted shape. The gem rests on a stepped circular base near rope rigging and a wooden railing. Her shoulder spikes, gloves, and boot buckles add small details beside the broad gem facets and deck planks of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Leaping Over a Land Shark Emerging From the Sand in Truck Stopped Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot leaps over a land shark emerging from the sand in this printable coloring page set in Truck Stopped from Crash Bandicoot 4. Her raised boots clear the shark's wide mouth and rows of triangular teeth. Scattered stones, cacti, and layered canyon walls surround the action, leaving large areas across Tawna's hair, clothing, and the sandy ground.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Crossing Moving Metal Platforms Between Flame Jets in Truck Stopped Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot crosses moving metal platforms between flame jets in this printable coloring page from the Truck Stopped level of Crash Bandicoot 4. Her forward stride stretches between large bolted platforms as tall flames rise from pipes on either side. The coloring sheet includes broad metal panels, circular machinery, small fasteners, and the folds of her leg warmers.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Hopping Across Giant Leaves Above a Pond in Potion Commotion Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot hops across giant leaves above a pond in this printable coloring page set in Potion Commotion, with one boot reaching the nearest leaf. Her outstretched arms balance the long jumping pose between rounded leaf platforms. Smaller lily pads, water ripples, hanging vines, and a waterfall give the coloring sheet a layered jungle setting without hiding the central figure.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Climbing a Pagoda with Wall Jumps Above the Waterfalls of Tranquility Falls Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot climbs a pagoda above the waterfalls of Tranquility Falls in this printable coloring page, reaching upward while one boot braces against a wooden beam. Her spiked jacket and bent climbing pose fill the foreground. Tiered waterfalls, cliff paths, small trees, and curved pagoda roofs form a detailed backdrop around the larger character shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Crossing Hanging Ropes Above a Snowy Ravine in Building Bridges Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot crosses a snowy ravine on a hanging rope in this printable coloring page set in Building Bridges, gripping the line with both hands. Her boots hang above the narrow stream below, while snow caps the rocky ledges. Long icicles, scattered fir trees, rope strands, and clothing folds provide smaller sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Watching Crash Ride Polar Across a Snowy Bridge with Coco Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot watches Crash ride Polar across a snowy bridge in this printable coloring page, with Coco running nearby between the icy canyon walls. Tawna stands prominently at the left with a hand on her hip. Polar's broad paws, the bridge's repeating planks, rope-wrapped posts, and snowy fir trees create varied shapes across this four-character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Grinding Along a Rail Above Flying City Traffic in Rush Hour Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot grinds along an elevated rail above flying city traffic in this printable coloring page set in Rush Hour from Crash Bandicoot 4. Her arms stretch outward for balance as her boots follow the curved track. Rounded towers, spires, hovering cars, and layered rails fill the coloring sheet with geometric background details around her large central silhouette.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot From Crash Bandicoot 4 Confronting the Female N. Tropy Beside the Rift Generator Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot confronts the female N. Tropy beside the rift generator in this printable coloring page, aiming her hookshot while standing in a wide stance. N. Tropy holds a tall staff and wears armor decorated with clock faces. A large circular portal, stepped floor panels, and rocky edges give the coloring sheet distinct mechanical and angular sections.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Driving Her Classic Kart with Aku Aku Floating Beside Her in Crash Team Racing Nitro-fueled Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot drives her classic kart with Aku Aku floating beside her in this printable coloring page inspired by Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled. Her flowing hair frames the steering wheel as the feathered mask follows near her shoulder. Wide tires, exposed suspension, an exhaust plume, and a curving tropical track add distinct shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Jumping Her Kart to Shake Off a Tnt Crate Balanced Above Her Head in Crash Team Racing Nitro-fueled Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot jumps her kart to shake off a TNT crate in this printable coloring page inspired by Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled, with all wheels airborne. The wooden box wobbles above her head beneath a sparking fuse. Thick tires, suspension springs, her wind-swept hair, and tropical trackside palms create a mixture of broad and narrow shapes to color.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Wearing Her Black Velvet Witch Costume and Pointed Hat Beside a Giant Pumpkin at Nina's Nightmare Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot wears her witch costume and pointed hat beside a giant pumpkin in this printable coloring page set at Nina's Nightmare beneath a full moon. Her laced bodice, jagged sleeves, and buckled boots complement the pumpkin's carved face. A winding stone path leads past flame-topped pillars toward a spired castle, adding detailed Halloween scenery to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Banking a Collection of Wumpa Fruit at Her Team's Wumpa Bank on Just Beachy in Crash Team Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot banks Wumpa fruit on Just Beachy in this printable coloring page from Crash Team Rumble, tossing fruit into her team's circular Wumpa Bank. She cradles another cluster against her side as the airborne fruit pass through stacked rings. Her spiked jacket, belt pouches, nearby palm tree, and scattered beach stones add distinct details around the open background.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Smashing a Wumpa Crate Beneath the Stone Ruins of Tiki Towers in Crash Team Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot smashes a Wumpa crate beneath the ruins of Tiki Towers in this printable coloring page from Crash Team Rumble, scattering fruit and splintered boards. Her punching pose fills the foreground between blocky stone structures. Carved tower faces, trailing vines, narrow bridges, and broken crate slats give the coloring sheet a mix of broad surfaces and angular details.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Capturing a Gem Platform Alongside Coco in Crash Team Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot captures a gem platform alongside Coco in this printable coloring page from Crash Team Rumble, with both characters raising their fists beside a floating crystal. Tawna's spiked jacket contrasts with Coco's overalls, goggles, and tall ponytail. Circular platform segments, rocky towers, and small palms add simple background shapes around the characters and the gem's pointed facets.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Delivering Relics to a Relic Station in Crash Team Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot delivers relics to a relic station in this printable coloring page from Crash Team Rumble, lowering one pointed token into its circular opening. She holds more relics against her chest beside the decorated pedestal. Repeating diamond emblems, stone steps, a rope bridge, and palm-topped ruins create smaller sections around her large figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot Wearing Her Retro Threads Outfit and Leading Crash and Coco Into the Tiki Towers Arena in Crash Team Rumble Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot leads Crash and Coco into the Tiki Towers arena in this printable coloring page from Crash Team Rumble, wearing her Retro Threads outfit. Her fruit-emblem crop top, cuffed shorts, and sneakers appear prominently as the trio runs forward. Patterned towers, suspended rope bridges, palm leaves, and uneven stone paving fill the arena behind them on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot in Crystal Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot stands inside a crystal cave in this printable coloring page, resting both hands on her hips between clusters of large pointed crystal formations. A tied headband, heart-emblem shirt, belt pouches, and high-top shoes distinguish her outfit. The coloring sheet pairs broad clothing and hair shapes with angular gem facets and the cave's uneven arch.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot in Cliffside Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot poses in a cliffside area in this printable coloring page, wearing a heart-emblem shirt, cuffed shorts, gloves, and boots above a deep rocky gap. Her tall ponytail and hand-on-hip stance form a large central silhouette. A narrow suspension bridge, scattered boulders, cacti, and simple clouds add smaller details around the open clothing areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot in Robot Factory Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot stands in a robot factory in this printable coloring page, with her hands on her hips beside a mechanical arm and small conveyor-belt robot. Her heart-emblem shirt, cuffed cargo trousers, and boots provide broad areas to color. Gears, control-panel gauges, pipes, ventilation grilles, and riveted flooring add a variety of industrial details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tawna Bandicoot in Desert Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna Bandicoot winks in a desert canyon in this printable coloring page, wearing a rolled-sleeve jacket over a star-emblem shirt with a tied neck scarf. Her high ponytail and beaded necklace frame the close-up portrait. Tall rock walls, distant mesas, scattered stones, and cacti fill the background, leaving broad hair and clothing shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Crash Bandicoot Tawna in Bamboo Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna from Crash Bandicoot stands in a bamboo jungle in this printable coloring page, wearing a flower beside her ear and a patterned sleeveless top. Her hand rests on her hip above cuffed shorts and sturdy boots. Tall segmented bamboo stalks, pointed leaves, and rounded bushes surround the figure, combining larger character areas with narrow botanical sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Crash Bandicoot Tawna on N Sanely Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna from Crash Bandicoot poses on N. Sanely Island in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles on her head and a broad-striped sleeveless cropped top. Her gloved hand rests on her hip beside a buckled utility belt. The large portrait leaves open sections across her swept hair and clothing, with a few palms, clouds, and distant peaks behind her.

pages.title: Crash Bandicoot Tawna in Treasure Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna from Crash Bandicoot appears inside a treasure cave in this printable coloring page, smiling in a star-emblem shirt with rounded shoulder pieces and a headband. Open and closed treasure chests sit among coin piles and faceted gems behind her. The coloring sheet contrasts the broad portrait shapes with small coins, chest fittings, and jagged cave contours.

pages.title: Crash Bandicoot Tawna in Ancient Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna from Crash Bandicoot stands in an ancient temple in this printable coloring page, wearing a headband, pocketed vest, cuffed shorts, gloves, and sturdy boots. A patterned stone arch frames her full figure beside cracked columns and steps. The circular wall carving, hanging vines, and geometric border add smaller sections around the larger clothing areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Crash Bandicoot Tawna in Hidden Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Tawna from Crash Bandicoot poses inside a hidden cave in this printable coloring page, with one hand on her hip beneath an uneven rocky arch. Her star-emblem shirt, cuffed shorts, gloves, and buckled boots stand out against hanging vines and pointed cave formations. A small floating crystal and leafy plants add compact details around her broad figure on the coloring sheet.
